title: Tweak it by hand — still code
intro: The ribbon works like a desktop CAD tool: pick a face or edges, type a number, OK. Under the hood every operation is written into the script, so hand edits and agent edits live in the same file.

steps.caption: Press/Pull (Q): click the boss top, drag the handle or type 5, OK.

The boss grew 5 mm. In the script the Plate expression became `_plate + extrude(_plate.faces().sort_by_distance((7, 0, 19))[0], amount=5, dir=(0, 0, 1))` — the face is referenced by the point you clicked.
Hole (H): click where it goes on the plate, choose a tapped M4, 6 deep.
A tap-drill hole at Ø3.3, registered as M4×0.7 so drawings call it out correctly.
Fillet (F): click the boss top face to take all of its edges, radius 2, OK.
Two fillets on the boss top: outer edge and bore edge.

steps.text:
_plate = plate.part
_plate2 = _plate + extrude(_plate.faces().sort_by_distance((7, 0, 19))[0], amount=5, dir=(0, 0, 1))
_plate3 = tap(_plate2, "M4", at=(18, 0, 4), depth=6, axis=(0, 0, -1))
result = {"Plate": _plate3.fillet(2, [*_plate3.faces().sort_by_distance((7, 0, 24))[0].edges()])}
steps.caption: Everything you did, as code. Undo steps back through it; the agent sees a note for each change.
